name: S1_phase_role
title: 上下文两位角色编码
description: Retain node_phase/more_steps caches, but encode three live KEY/MASK/MASK1 bank flags using a 2-bit role. All phase transitions and requests keep their prior logical role.
risk: Removing or encoding cached control can add decode on the return critical path; source register-bit reduction is not established synthesized area benefit.
scope: All fixed shapes and families on the existing valid-tag/active-context permutation protocol; no tree-height or P/U-specific assumptions.
